Game Overview

At its heart, Super Soldier Mech Assault is a platformer game about battle through a futuristic world as either of two heroes in Super Soldier Mech Assault. Engage in dynamic combat against diverse robotic foes with simple controls and strategic shooting and slashing. Explore hidden spots, gather valuable items, and survive five thrilling levels in this exciting adventure for all ages.
